item.text: The existing implementation already supports notes and remembered task positions. I’ll add a saved deletion flag so deletion preserves task data and ordering, while summaries count only live tasks. Deleted rows will remain readable with editing and movement disabled, and the server will enforce those restrictions.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('test/projects.test.js');s=p.read_text().replace(\"due_date: '', notes: '' }\", \"due_date: '', notes: '', deleted: false }\");p.write_text(s)
p=Path('README.md');s=p.read_text().replace('shows All, Open, or Completed\\ntasks', 'shows All, Open, Completed, or Deleted\\ntasks').replace('project summaries always count every task.', 'project summaries always count every live task.');s+='''
Delete task removes a live task from ordinary filters and completion summaries
without losing any saved fields or remembered positions. The Deleted filter
shows deleted tasks with the same priority, date range, and title search rules.
Restore task returns a task to its reserved position; tasks created later remain
after it. Deleted task fields and move controls are read-only until restoration.
Archived projects also disable deletion and restoration. Deletion state persists
across restarts; existing databases initialize all earlier tasks as live.
''';p.write_text(s)
PY
node --check server.js && node --check public/app.js && npm test"
